anchor_quote:
The same
argument with the formula \(x\notin B\) gives
\(z\in A\setminus B\leftrightarrow(z\in A\land z\notin B)\).
text:
The relative
complement \(A\setminus B\) is the separated set \(\{x\in A:x\notin B\}\),
formed with the \(\Lang_{\in}\)-formula \(x\notin B\), that is
\(\neg\,x\in B\) (parameter \(B\)), in which the formed variable is not free;
\cref{thm:p01-w02b-p01-004-relative-complement} writes out this application of
\cref{thm:p01-w02-p01-005-separated-set} and gives
\(z\in A\setminus B\leftrightarrow(z\in A\land z\notin B)\) for every \(z\).
reason: MP-0 (X-1), membership clause 3: the proof deferred to 'the same argument'. The full application of the separated-set lemma to x notin B is written in annex:p01-w02b-p01-004-relative-complement; this replacement removes the deferral and points to it. No circularity: that proof uses only thm:p01-w02-p01-005-separated-set and def:p01-w02-p01-005-operations.

anchor_quote:
The same argument with \(\cap\) and
\cref{thm:p01-w02-p01-005-membership}(2) gives a function \(G_{\cap}\).
text:
For intersection, \(G_{\cap}\) is the separated set
\(G^{Q}_{\cap}=\{w\in(Q\times Q)\times Q:\gamma_{\cap}(w,Q)\}\) of
\cref{def:p01-w02b-p01-004-graph}, formed with the \(\Lang_{\in}\)-formula
\(\gamma_{\cap}\) of \cref{def:p01-w02b-p01-004-formulas} with parameter
\(Q\); by \cref{thm:p01-w02b-p01-004-intersection-on-subsets}, whose proof
verifies the bound through \(X\cap Y\in Q\) and totality and
single-valuedness through the ordered-pair identity, it is a function from
\(Q\times Q\) to \(Q\) with value \(X\cap Y\) at \(\langle X,Y\rangle\).
reason: MP-0 (X-1), subset-algebra: the G_cap step deferred to 'the same argument'. The separation formula, the bound check, totality and single-valuedness are written in annex:p01-w02b-p01-004-intersection-graph and annex:p01-w02b-p01-004-intersection-on-subsets; this replacement removes the deferral and points to them. No circularity: those proofs use membership clause 2, the product bound and the separated-set lemma only.
